newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Chariot still in talks on acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Chariot still in talks on acquisition.

text.p: Automotive parts group Chariot Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday that talks to acquire the entire share capital of Rubenstein Finance Co (Pty) Ltd and Hazemar Leasing and Finance Co (Pty) Ltd were continuing.
If the talks were successfully concluded, they could affect Chariot's share price and shareholders should exercise caution in their sharedealings until further notice, it said.

The company said on February 12 that the deal was to be retrospective from September 1, 1996. The purchase price is 14 million rand, to be settled by the issue of 20 million new shares at 70 cents each.
